description: Static assertions for ip-screen (block B2 of ip-invent) — the block holding the pipeline's load-bearing rule: score protectability and credential-value on TWO SEPARATE AXES and never average them, because the axes are anti-correlated (deployed = strong application evidence but disclosed; unbuilt = clean novelty but no application evidence). Must also preserve: Điều 60.3 twelve-month grace computation from a real date, Điều 10a AI-authorship gate that blocks back to B1, four-way routing including secret patents with its two unanswered questions stated, Điều 14a fast-examination condition table, three paths A/B/C presented without the AI choosing, GPHI-vs-patent inventive-step distinction, and the industrial-applicability vs already-applied distinction. All regex windows bounded — an unbounded [\s\S]* match is a keyword gate, not an assertion.
test_input: rà soát khả thi hai ứng viên: một cơ cấu chưa bộc lộ chưa chế tạo, và một sản phẩm đã triển khai ngoài biển từ 2024

assertions.name: forbidden_to_average_axes
assertions.check: explicitly forbids collapsing the two axes into one total score, with the reason that averaging hides the conflict the CEO needs to see
assertions.regex: KHÔNG được cộng hai trục thành một điểm tổng[\s\S]{0,220}che

assertions.name: axes_are_anti_correlated
assertions.check: states the anti-correlation: deployed/commercialised = strong application evidence but disclosed; unbuilt = clean novelty but no evidence
assertions.regex: Đã triển khai[\s\S]{0,120}Chưa chế tạo, chưa lộ[\s\S]{0,120}không có

assertions.name: twelve_month_grace_computed_from_real_date
assertions.check: computes the Điều 60.3 grace deadline as disclosure date + 12 months and compares to today, rather than guessing

assertions.name: grace_only_saves_domestic_filing
assertions.check: warns the 12-month grace only rescues a filing made in Vietnam; prior disclosure generally forfeits foreign/PCT options
assertions.regex: cửa 12 tháng chỉ cứu đơn[\s\S]{0,60}VIỆT NAM[\s\S]{0,120}(nước ngoài|PCT)

assertions.name: undatable_disclosure_is_high_risk_not_safe
assertions.check: an undatable disclosure must be treated as HIGH RISK, never as not-yet-disclosed
assertions.regex: (Ngày bộc lộ không tra được|không tra được)[\s\S]{0,60}RỦI RO CAO[\s\S]{0,60}không coi như

assertions.name: ai_authorship_gate_blocks_back_to_b1
assertions.check: Điều 10a gate blocks and returns to B1 when human substantial contribution cannot be documented

assertions.name: names_the_authorship_failure_mode
assertions.check: names the concrete failure mode: a granted patent that cannot be used for the credential because authorship is shaky
assertions.regex: có bằng mà không dùng được cho chức danh

assertions.name: four_way_routing_with_secret_patent
assertions.check: routing table has four destinations including sáng chế MẬT as the unpublished track

assertions.name: secret_patent_open_questions_stated
assertions.check: when proposing the secret-patent route, states the two unanswered questions — missing implementing circular, and whether a secret patent can be evidenced in a credential dossier
assertions.regex: hai câu chưa có đáp án[\s\S]{0,400}chứng minh được trong hồ sơ chức danh

assertions.name: three_paths_presented_not_chosen
assertions.check: presents paths A/B/C with trade-offs and explicitly refuses to choose, because the trade-off is a CEO Core decision
assertions.regex: bày cả ba, không tự chọn

assertions.name: fast_examination_condition_table
assertions.check: evaluates all Điều 14a conditions including the claim cap and the timing traps (early-publication request at filing, divisional applications excluded)

assertions.name: gphi_does_not_require_inventive_step
assertions.check: states GPHI does not require inventive step but does require not-common-knowledge — the main routing pivot
assertions.regex: GPHI không đòi trình độ sáng tạo

assertions.name: industrial_applicability_is_not_already_applied
assertions.check: distinguishes Điều 62 industrial applicability (protection condition) from đã được áp dụng (credential condition)
assertions.regex: khả năng áp dụng \*\*công nghiệp\*\*[\s\S]{0,140}đã được áp dụng

assertions.name: prior_art_searched_by_claim_feature_not_application_name
assertions.check: requires searching prior art per claim FEATURE and per feature-pair, not by application name; only 🟢 when every pair is clean
assertions.regex: TRA THEO TỪNG DẤU HIỆU CỦA CLAIM, KHÔNG THEO TÊN ỨNG DỤNG[\s\S]{0,900}từng cặp dấu hiệu

assertions.name: academic_literature_counts_as_prior_art
assertions.check: requires searching academic literature (papers/proceedings/theses) because Điều 60.1 counts written description anywhere in the world, not only patents
assertions.regex: PHẢI TRA CẢ TÀI LIỆU HỌC THUẬT[\s\S]{0,500}(Scholar|ScienceDirect|Springer)
